sentences.en: The dismantling of the British Empire was relatively peaceful.
sentences.zh: 英国帝国的瓦解相对平和。

sentences.en: They will relinquish power and dismantle the single-party state.
sentences.zh: 他们将放弃权力并废除一党制国家。

sentences.en: Dan sent the machines to a site where they would be dismantled.
sentences.zh: 丹把机器送到拆解地点。

senses.zh: 拆除；取消；解散；除掉…的覆盖物
